purpose: Prevent held-out tuning while respecting PolliPi's frozen ordinal direct-target scale and keeping C/N calibrations effect-specific.

historical_development_defaults_retired_.field_status: not carried forward as V15-v2 field boundaries

direct_target_route.rule: retain frozen 0/0.5/1 exactly; do not rethreshold as a continuous probability

field_nuisance_mapping_required.input: FieldNuisanceProcessMeasurement plus development-only nuisance truth/effect labels
field_nuisance_mapping_required.runtime_representation: each output is independently mapped to ordinal 0/0.5/1 support
field_nuisance_mapping_required.rule: Each nuisance effect must retain its own predeclared feature, low/high boundary and calibration SHA. One scalar cannot silently be copied into all three effects.

hard_rules: all continuous C/N boundaries and selected nuisance features are frozen from development-only data
no threshold or feature choice may use held-out outcomes
PolliPi direct evidence remains ordinal and is never converted to biological absence
field nuisance process index is not a calibrated probability by itself
claim thresholds are separate from observer operational calibration
O thresholds/calibration remain a separate readiness item
freeze_output_required: coupled low/high ordinal boundary and calibration SHA
separate nuisance feature + low/high boundary + calibration SHA for false-event, missed-event and attribution effects
SHA-256 of the final operational calibration artifact
claim_boundary: Runtime calibration schema exists, but no C/N field boundary is frozen yet. Held-out T/C/N operation remains blocked until development-only calibration is committed and SHA-registered.
